With a title on the line and plenty of history hovering in the background, it’s a World Baseball Classic title fight fans could only have dreamed of.This Venezuelan team has played with equal parts joy and edge throughout the tournament. From the pregame drum circles in the dugout to the relentless at-bats late in games, the energy has been impossible to miss. That spirit showed up again Monday night, when Venezuela erased a deficit and surged past Italy with a seventh-inning rally fueled by some of the game’s most dangerous bats. When the lineup turns over and two outs don’t matter, it feels like something is about to happen.The matchup adds another layer of intrigue. Venezuela is chasing its first WBC championship appearance after years of near misses, while also remembering the sting of losing to the U.S. in 2023, when a late lead vanished in Miami. This time, the Venezuelans arrive battle-tested, having already rallied from deep holes earlier in the tournament.On the mound, Eduardo Rodríguez is lined up to start for Venezuela, while the Americans counter with Nolan McLean.
